item.title: OpenAI raises $40B at $500B valuation in record funding round
item.description: OpenAI has closed a 40 billion dollar round at a 500 billion dollar valuation, the largest private funding round in tech history, with softbank and sovereign funds participating.
item.author: TC Staff

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude for Government with FedRAMP compliance
item.description: Anthropic announced Claude for Government, a FedRAMP-compliant offering targeting public sector agencies, expanding its enterprise business.
item.author: TC Staff

item.title: EU AI Act enforcement begins: first fines issued to big tech
item.description: European regulators issued the first fines under the EU AI Act, targeting transparency violations in deployed AI systems across the industry.
item.author: TC Staff

item.title: Manus declares independence: founders return to lead the AI agent lab
item.description: AI agent company Manus announced it will operate independently again, with its founders returning to lead the lab and continue building general agent capabilities.
item.author: TC Staff
